value: This article provides a comprehensive overview of user interface (UI) design, defining it as the critical human-machine interaction point focused on maximizing usability and user experience across diverse devices. It outlines various interface types—including graphical, voice, and gesture-controlled—and details the user-centered design thinking process, which encompasses empathy, definition, ideation, prototyping, and testing. The text also distinguishes UI's visual and interactive focus from the broader concept of user experience (UX), and describes evaluation methods like usability testing alongside foundational standards such as ISO 9241, which establish principles for effective dialogue, information presentation, and comprehensive user guidance.
